name: Necromantic Rituals — 2 Intermediate — Din of the Damned

system.description: Draw an unbroken line of crematorium ash around the perimeter of a room. Until dawn, anyone attempting to eavesdrop on the room (mundane, technological, or supernatural) must win a Static Mental Challenge against a nine-Trait difficulty or be partially deafened by ghostly howling, gaining two Oblivious Negative Mental Traits for the rest of the night.
